StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236 -- no StackType branch). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

ModifyMaxEnergy.rationale: `player != base.Owner.Player -> amount` else `amount - base.Amount` maps exactly to powers.py:2692-2694. Checked deliberately: NEITHER side clamps at 0, so a Waste Away larger than the energy gain produces a negative gain on both -- and the sim then assigns it straight to `self.energy` (player.py:165), which is what C# does too. The sim reproducing an unclamped subtraction rather than tidying it is the right call. Third-file citations, not hashed here.
